description: This file defines utility methods for type safety checks and casting within the Apache OFBiz framework, including generic checkers for collections and maps.

classes.name: UtilGenerics
classes.description: A final utility class providing methods for generic casting and type validation for collections and maps.

methods.name: cast
methods.description: Performs unchecked casting of an object to a specified type.

methods.name: checkCollection
methods.description: Validates that an object is a collection of a specified element type, throwing exceptions if not.

methods.name: checkMap
methods.description: Validates that an object is a map with keys and values of specified types, throwing exceptions if not.
